studies.A: Historical extractive study; exact completed principal-run archive not present in inspected repository commit
studies.B: Frozen 64-question real-LLM study; retrospective reanalysis only
studies.C: Prospective follow-up proposed here; no responses generated

outcomes: Primary in adjudicated route: semantic endorsement of an independently documented false target proposition
Secondary: numeric containment, EM/F1; factual correctness per completed rubric
RQ1.automatic_fallback: Before freeze, explicitly change primary endpoint and claims to designated-value production if actual semantic adjudication is unavailable; not completion of semantic primary

outcomes: retrieval-only stress of rejecting an answer-required legitimate support
RQ4.operational_claim: No measured real-world authorization or security guarantee

selection.development: Existing observed Study B cases; cannot be called untouched test cases again
selection.preferred_source: Unused HotpotQA validation candidates from pinned HF revision 1908d6afbbead072334abe2965f91bd2709910ab
selection.feasibility_fallback: Before outputs, check train at same pinned revision if insufficient eligible validation groups; version and document any change
selection.exclude_prior: All 128 B test and donor IDs and titles; compare A inputs and shared facts/supports
selection.grouping: Keep shared entity-relation-time facts and support groups within a single role; title disjointness alone is insufficient
selection.eligibility: Documented exact relation/time/unit and reference, evidenced contradiction of designated false value, verified donor unrelatedness; exclude unresolved/ambiguous cases before outputs
selection.control_pairing: Targeted and unrelated insertions use the same designated false value; validate that it is also false for the donor relation, not merely unrelated to the test question
selection.attack_documentation: Report creation method, text structure, word/token counts, vocabulary and similarity to clean material; do not assume unrelated and targeted natural exposure are equal

retrieval.tie_break: stable corpus order, frozen in protocol
retrieval.reranker: TF-IDF fit on query and candidate texts; exact implementation and dependency versions frozen before outputs

core.gate: verified AND trust in {high,medium}, before retrieval; all clean passages accepted, base insertions rejected; accepted_label changes only labels on identical targeted passages

controlled_exposure.context: 2 complete support passages + 2 fixed clean distractors + 1 replacement slot; clean filler and inserted passages matched in length
controlled_exposure.slot: Balanced across ranks before outputs and fixed across arms per question; other passages unchanged
controlled_exposure.ineligible: Exclude from this module before freeze if two passages do not cover all required support; report actual denominator

optional_fixed_target_dose.status: Predefine inclusion before core outputs; independent of favorable/unfavorable core results
optional_fixed_target_dose.text_variants: Same text; distinct IDs; retain exact duplicates with documented ordering

legitimate_support_rejection_stress.scope: Retrieval only; not final-answer utility or operational authentication
legitimate_support_rejection_stress.treatment: Per-question paired index variants: select lowest lexicographically sorted support ID before outputs; compare accepting versus rejecting that support with identical text
legitimate_support_rejection_stress.controls: All accepted; selected support rejected; or lowest sorted eligible clean non-support rejected; compare with and without filtering. Each question has separate index variants, not simultaneous label changes to all questions.

generation.statistical_warning: Fresh provider invocations do not guarantee statistically independent draws; 64 questions do not become 192 independent questions
generation.model_unavailable: Fail closed; select and refreeze an explicit new protocol before new inference, never silently substitute a local model or provider

budget.exact_count: Compute frozen payload hash census before generation; counts can be lower
budget.embedding_calls: Count unique embedding texts/tokens and SDK batches separately; cache exact duplicate texts
budget.money: Use verified current rates and actual frozen token census; include retry contingency and enforce a recorded ceiling before dispatch

axes: support from any provided context, including poison
evaluation.lexical_metrics: Keep numerical containment, EM and token F1 explicitly separate from semantic correctness
evaluation.human_preferred: Two actual independent English-proficient reviewers, initially blinded to defense/condition labels, automatic scores and each other; adjudicate after recording initial labels
evaluation.unit: Exact question-context-response tuple, with mappings to all reused rows retained
evaluation.if_no_humans: Continue engineering and report automatic assessment with scope limits; no independent semantic or human-validation claim
evaluation.old_results: Preserve archived B scores unchanged; corrected version and reasons in separate retrospective analysis
evaluation.route_decision: Record human/adjudicated versus automatic route and primary endpoint before final freeze
evaluation.reference_vs_question_change: Rescoring the same question with a corrected reference differs from changing the question; archived answers are never represented as responses to a rewritten question

analysis.primary_unit: Question or group of shared facts/supports, not condition row
analysis.rounds: Report per-round results; do not equate cache reuse with replications

bootstrap.scope: descriptive conditional on this shared corpus and frozen protocol, retain within-group paired conditions and rounds

analysis.if_groups_inadequate: Use paired tables and per-round ranges, without confirmatory population claims
analysis.missingness: Errors and unresolved outputs are unknown, not failures; report lower/upper rates with planned denominator, plus paired-complete sensitivity analysis with explicit denominator
analysis.aggregation: Mean of three fresh rounds within question, then mean across questions; never replace with any-of-three attack success as primary

freeze_gates: reference audit and evaluator versions recorded
new execution guard passes offline tamper/no-dispatch check
eligible test/donor selection feasible and final
all unresolved reference cases handled before outputs
all conditions/context payloads and analysis frozen
exact request/token census and money ceiling recorded
delivery: formal Dari report and point-by-point response
all four preexisting figures preserved with provenance
exclude API keys and confidential files
Per-source license, attribution, redistribution permission/uncertainty and access-instruction inventory
historical_fallback: If exact archive cannot be recovered, document the unresolved gap and restrict historical claims; optional A-prime reimplementation is explicitly new, not an automatic completion requirement

freeze_phases.before_embeddings: Freeze validated data, code, embedding texts, embedding requests/model/settings and selection/evaluation rules; verify these fields before every embedding dispatch
freeze_phases.before_generation: Freeze returned vectors, candidate/final contexts and all generation requests linked to the initial manifest; verify complete generation inputs before every generation dispatch, including empty-cache and resume paths
